caption: The drawing displays a wrought iron gate or fence detail as its central feature, consisting of a large cross with symmetrical scrollwork at its base, and a rounded, solid lower section that transitions into a bar with five vertical posts extending downward. The cross has circular loops at the tips of both the vertical and horizontal arms. Two additional smaller, inset diagrams appear in the upper corners; the top left inset shows three finial designs, each with intricate floral or leafy patterns in brown hues, positioned on a horizontal bar with short vertical posts below. The upper right inset is a line drawing showing a simplified version of the main cross feature above a series of vertical bars, also incorporating the curved scroll motifs. The drawing uses mostly brown and sepia tones for the ironwork, with pencil outlines for the additional diagrams, all set on a pale, cream-colored background.
title: Cross
